title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_historia_de_un_oso_by_gabriel_osorio_antonia_herrera_ti9e1 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_historia_de_un_oso_by_gabriel_osorio_antonia_herrera_ti9e1' is identified as malicious software. Installing or running this package results in a fully compromised system, potentially allowing an attacker full control. Immediate removal of the package is advised, along with rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device. However, removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to the extensive control gained by the attacker.
